options.content:
### What this dashboard can and cannot see

**Fully instrumented** — `spark-connect-server` exposes the Spark
`PrometheusServlet` on port 4040. All 467 `metrics_spark_driver_*`
series come from this one pod, and drive every panel above.

**Not instrumented — the batch pipelines.** The scheduled
`SparkApplication` drivers (`logistics-*`, `nav-data-raw`,
`manual-nav-data`, `dri`) emit **no** Spark metrics. Their scrape
targets report `up = 0`, which is what keeps the `TargetDown` alert on
`default/spark-monitor` firing. The *Batch pipelines* row is therefore
built from kube-state-metrics and cAdvisor — pod lifecycle, duration
and resources only. No job, stage, task or shuffle detail.

**Not instrumented — executors.** `spark-executor-exec-3` is running
but exposes no metrics, so there are no `metrics_spark_executor_*`
series anywhere. Shuffle read/write volume is consequently
unavailable — it is an executor-only metric.

**Double scrape.** Every Connect-server series is collected twice, by
job `spark-connect-server` *and* job `spark-ui-headless`. Every query
here pins `job="spark-connect-server"` so nothing is counted twice —
drop that filter and all totals double.
